_note: OcuScan master medical capability catalog (v0.7). Statuses: CURRENT (in app now), RESEARCH-SUPPORTED, EXPERIMENTAL, FUTURE, HARDWARE-REQUIRED, UNSUPPORTED. Validation: NOT IMPLEMENTED everywhere unless stated (no clinical validation exists). References are curated evidence IDs; empty means no precedent curated. Never a diagnosis list.
